text: で　そのつりざおで　でっかい　コイキング　つったら　わしに　みせに　こないか？

structure.jp: でっかい　コイキング　つったら
structure.en: if you catch a huge Magikarp

structure.jp: わしに　みせに　こないか？
structure.en: won't you come show it to me?

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: A verb cut short (みせます without ます) plus に before 'come' or 'go' tells what you come or go to do. みせに　くる = 'come to show'.

patterns.name: 〜ないか
patterns.explanation: Asking with 'not' plus か is a way to invite someone: 'won't you?'. みせに　こないか = 'won't you come and show me?'

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'once that happens'. コイキング　つったら = 'if you catch a Magikarp'.
